==Localization problem==

There are two ways:
#either we make this page as localizable as the main page
#or we create different News pages for different languages as it's done for Wave Lessons

I prefer the second solution because it allows for different names of pages. Hence we'll have "lojbo nuzba", "Lojban News", "Новости о ложбане" etc. '''which is good for SEO'''.

Until recently Google displayed "Lo Lojbo Nuzba" page which for most newcomers is undecipherable.

===Important actions===
Although a simple redirect to "Lojban News" fixes this problem we are losing neutrality and multilinguality. So if someone has free time it'd be nice to make a bunch of pages for most important languages.
